title: The Nihilist Reading Of The Last Faust #Shorts
description:
The self that experiences The Last Faust is a committee, not a king. The Last Faust is a 2019 feature art film written and directed by the German artist Philipp Humm. Set in 2059, it is a contemporary interpretation of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's 1808 Faust and the first film directly based on both parts of the tragedy.

The cold light on The Last Faust leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. Women were unfairly treated for childbirth outside of wedlock while their seducers were able to escape; an injustice Goethe represented through the Gretchen tragedy. One could argue that the Catholic Church made Faust possible, in particular, the dark sides of Faust.
